warrants.quote: Each public warrant entitles the holder thereof to purchase one share of common stock at a price of $11.50 per share, subject to adjustment.
The Private Placement Warrants were immediately exercisable upon issuance at an exercise price of $2.40 per share and will expire on September 8, 2027.
The Private Pre-Funded Warrants were immediately exercisable at an exercise price of $0.0001 per share and will expire when the Private Pre-Funded Warrants are fully exercised.
